documents.title: Master services agreement
documents.text:
Master services agreement — Sorrel Holdings (fictional).
In this document "SHH" means Sorrel Holdings. Sorrel Holdings reports termination notice period of 144 days for FY2025. Sorrel Holdings reports maximum service credit of 12.8% for FY2025. Sorrel Holdings reports uptime commitment of 99.509% for FY2025. Sorrel Holdings reports annual price escalator of 6.4% for FY2025. For Sorrel Holdings, the governing law is read as: English law, London-seated arbitration.

documents.title: Amendment letter
documents.text:
Amendment letter — Sorrel Holdings (fictional).
Sorrel Holdings: termination notice period for FY2025 — not provided. Sorrel Holdings reports maximum service credit of 16.4% for FY2024. Sorrel Holdings reports term years of 2 years for FY2025 under the original agreement. Sorrel Logistics subsidiary reports annual fee of $4.3m for FY2024 on a reported basis. For Sorrel Holdings, the governing law is read as: Swedish law, Stockholm courts.
